name: Last Hit
description:
About This Game

Join the community on Discord & Follow us on X: @PlayLastHit

Last Hit is a fantasy strategy card game built around battlefield positioning. Deploy units with your cards, plan your formation, and take on increasingly powerful forces of darkness. Choose from four factions and 16 heroes. Each faction has its own card synergies, and every hero brings a unique ability to the fight—giving you plenty of ways to shape your strategy. All of this unfolds in a distinctive medieval fantasy world, brought to life with hand-drawn art.

Position Your Units. Shape the Battle.

Choosing which card to play is only half the decision. Where you place each unit matters just as much. A weaker unit in the right position can make all the difference. Will you use your units to attack or defend? Every placement is a strategic choice.

Build More Than a Deck

Shape the battlefield itself and empower your units with the effects of the field. You’re not just building a deck—you’re building the whole battlefield.

Let the Combos Roll

With the right build and positioning, your units, field cards, hero, and relics can all work together. Playing a card or using a skill can trigger other effects on the field. One chain of synergies can keep going for half a minute—or unleash dozens of effects in an instant. Every battle pairs deep strategy with explosive payoff.

A Wealth of Strategies to Discover

Each of the four factions has its own deck and distinct playstyle. Take on the challenge as one of 16 heroes, each with a powerful signature ability to support your strategy. Harness the Sanctum’s powerful buffs, the Academy’s spell synergies, the Demons’ endless summons, or the Elves’ interconnected root network. There are countless strategies waiting to be discovered.

There’s plenty to explore, including:

  • 4 distinct factions

  • 300+ deployable units

  • 90+ field cards

  • 16 heroes, each with a unique playstyle

  • Dozens of monsters

  • A wealth of relics and events

Hand-Drawn Cards, Full of Character

Explore more than 350 hand-drawn card illustrations, each with its own distinctive medieval fantasy style. Every card also has a foil version waiting to be unlocked. All artwork is drawn by hand, with no AI-generated art.

English Localization

We worked with a professional English localization team to polish the game’s English text and provide a smoother experience for English-speaking players. Have a suggestion for the localization? We’d love to hear your feedback on discord!

Elevatia Studio

We’re an emerging indie game development team based in Chengdu, China. We bring mechanics, technology, and art together at the same workbench, refining original games into interactive experiences worth exploring again and again.

Uneoon

We’re an indie game publishing group founded by seasoned marketing professionals. As passionate players, we understand what makes indie games tick, and we’ve built a network connecting tens of thousands of indie game developers. We also keep a close eye on emerging subcultures, exploring and testing new ways to support independent game development in China.
short_desc: LASTHIT is an original indie game that blends tactical strategy, roguelike elements, and deck-building. As the commander, you defend against monster invasions by positioning your troops and increasing your combat power—striking with the last hit to eliminate enemies before they go berserk.
